w: In the evening assembly, Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored in the presence of Swamishri. During his blessings, Swamishri emphasized the need to conserve water in the prevailing drought that has gripped the region of Saurashtra: "Today, there is a severe crises of water. When the rains fail we realize the importance of water. And during the hot summer months we get anxious, criticize and angrily voice our opinions and even fight for water. But by merely shouting nothing is achieved. You have to think individually and act. There are some people in Saurashtra who are aware and active to the need for conserving water. It is time to unite and realize that we have to save water. If you endeavor to make arrangements for collecting water then it will benefit everyone. For the present don't waste water, use it judiciously…"
Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha rituals of murtis for the Swaminarayan Mandir for women in the village of Chachana.
Through mandirs one is inspired with dharma and faith in God.
When one understand mundane happiness as temporary, then one will not be desirous of them.

In the morning Swamishri arrived at Paliyad for the 'Amra Bapu Murti-Pratishtha Mahotsav.' First Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of a canvas murti of Amra Bapu in a mandir and then went to the 'Sadhus' Get Together' program. The inauguration of the entrance to the festival ground was performed by Swamishri and Jagadguru Shri Ramnareshacharyaji. Then both dignitaries kindled the inaugural lamp of the festival. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
At 6.30 p.m. Swamishri arrived at Lathi village where a public assembly was arranged on the diamond grounds of the renowned diamond businessman Shri Manji Rudabhai Dholakiya.

At 7.45 p.m. Swamishri arrived at the public satsang assembly in Amreli. Corporators of the local Amreli Municipality presented a citation of honor to Swamishri. An official of Rotary Club presented a citation of honor to Swamishri. On behalf of the Red Cross Society, Amreli, a philanthropist presented a citation of honor to Swamishri. Many other organizations of Amreli also welcomed and honored Swamishri. In his blessings Swamishri said, "Amreli is a blessed land. Formerly it was under the jurisdiction ofthe Gaekwad State and it introduced education on a compulsory basis. Many people have acquired good education and become scholars and citizens of character. Our importance lies in having character. Character is an asset. If character is lost then everything is lost..."
ph: Swamishri and Shri Ramnareshacharyaji perform the opening ceremony of the festival at the main entrance

w: Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Radha-Krishna Dev, Shri Sita-Ram, Shri Shiv-Parvati, Shri Hanumanji and Shri Ganapatiji for the hari mandir in Deesa, and Shri Hanumanji and Shri Gana-patiji for the hari mandir in Visnagar.

During Swamishri's evening walk, for the Shri Hari festival, Shantmuni Swami gave a talk in English on 'Niyamakaya namah' (salutations to the One who governs) and Purnajivan Swami on 'Svatantraya namah' (salutations to the One who is independent), and also translated them. While the talk on 'Svatantraya namah' was going on, it was time for a rest break in the walk. Swamishri sat on a chair. So Yogicharan Swami said, "Please say a sentence."
"What should I say?" Swamishri hesitated.
The sadhus said, "You are independent. Say whatever you like."
Hearing this, Swamishri said at once, "Where are we independent! We are subject to God. God alone is independent. He runs the whole system and keeps it going."
This unique devotion of Swamishri as a servant touched everyone.

ds.t: There is no title like sadhu
w: This evening, while Swamishri was seated offering food to Thakorji, Aksharcharan Swami began introducing the work of some sadhus and said, "You know this one, of course."
"No. I do not know anyone," Swamishri said with a straight face.
Hearing this, that sadhu said, "If you do not know me, how will I be liberated?"
"Then there will be trouble there too!" Swamishri gave an unexpected answer with a smile. Everyone laughed.
Then Swamishri began, "I know Ramchandra Kaka, I know his brother Bhailal, I also know Bhailal's son Kanaiyalal. Kanaiyalal means Kanu. I know his son Bhaskar. And you are his..."
Recalling four generations like this, Swamishri described the whole family line, and everyone was amazed.

When that sadhu was a student doing higher studies in America, he had wished that he too might become President of America. With this in mind Swamishri said, "Now that you have come here, you have become President."
"How?"
"One who remembers Shriji Maharaj and takes His refuge, there is no one like him. After meeting God and the Sant, what is left? There is no title like that of a sadhu!"

A student in tenth grade came for darshan. He had fallen into a bad habit of misusing his mobile. Because of this habit he was slowly losing concentration. Pointing this out, Swamishri said, "In life you are not to fail; you are to succeed. This wrong habit you have now will trouble you all your life. So give it all up. Obey your parents. If you go the wrong way, your life will be spoiled, so pay attention to your studies now. Study properly. Turn five malas and pray, so that all these habits leave you."

Swamishri blessed a young man named Brijrajsinh. In a wide borewell near his village, a little boy had slipped twenty five feet down. The fire brigade came, but there was no way they could get the boy out. So the firemen said to the crowd that had gathered to watch, "One of you come here. We will tie ropes to his feet and lower him head first twenty five feet, so that he can grab the boy's hands and bring him up." No one in the crowd was willing. The satsangi youth Brijrajsinh was passing by. He saw that 'a life can be saved', so he got ready himself, went head first down the twenty five foot borewell with its very narrow width, saved the boy and brought him out. He did this brave act only through Swamishri's spiritual strength, and the newspapers reported it too. Swamishri blessed him with great joy.
After his evening walk, Swamishri was sitting on a chair to rest. The sadhus were sitting in front.
Dr. Kiran said, "When the white doctors in Atlanta came to see you, they were amazed at such good health at 90!!"
Swamishri said at once, "So many devotees do japa, austerities, vows and prayers! Some do dharna parna fasts, some walk on pilgrimage. All this becomes blessings, my brother, and so it goes on."
Narayancharan Swami said, "Please listen to all their austerities, vows and prayers for your good health."
Swamishri said, "God listens. That is why everything is, and goes on, by His grace and kindness."

Brahmavihari Swami said, "At 90, people can hardly even speak! Seeing the way you work, many are amazed. Yogeshbhai Lakhani came to the opening of the show. He is a very big lawyer. He said, 'The blessings Pramukh Swami gave at this age, without a break, and the clarity in them, were simply wonderful.'"

Then, as the water show came up, Brahmavihari Swami said, "Everyone who has seen the water show gives wonderful comments. You have put in divine power and divinity; this is its glory. If anyone else tried to do this, they simply could not."
Swamishri was listening in silence, so Brahmavihari Swami said, "Isn't that right? Do say something."
Swamishri said, "What is there to say?"
Swamishri said nothing, so the talk went on.
Dr. Kiranbhai Doshi said, "To do this at the age of 90 takes courage."
Brahmavihari Swami said, "And then fifty problems come, and they all come onto your chest."
Swamishri said, "It is all God's courage. He is seated on this chest, so the work gets done."
Brahmavihari Swami said, "However many problems come, not a line on your face changes. Even when we come with problems, after hearing them you are just as calm."

Swamishri said, "It is like this! Everyone together pulls the cart. The devotees and sadhus are all like that. The dedication is like that too. In the time of Shriji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj there was the same dedication. So, my brother, the work gets done."
Swamishri stayed completely untouched by all the credit.
During the break in his walk, Swamishri does exercises. As the exercises began now, the sadhus sitting in front spoke of some proud moments of the BAPS organisation. Swamishri was listening.

As soon as the exercises were over, Swamishri spoke from the depths of his heart: "Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj have laid the roots of the organisation deep. Even a two year old child has the spirit of dedication; who would go to explain it to him otherwise? Young and old all have the feeling from inside. Everyone dedicates themselves to the organisation."
Meanwhile Yogicharan Swami spoke of some other people who had said that what BAPS has done, they could never do.

In this connection Swamishri said, "Here young and old all have just one thought, that they must do something for the organisation. Outside there are officers who meet and part; how can work get done that way? Here it is the resolve of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, so young and old all feel that this work must be done well. Dedication in every way: with the body and with wealth. Children save their pocket money and give it here, feeling that the organisation's work must be done. There, officers come, look and part. But here there is great depth. Everyone has feeling, everyone has dedication. It is in the soul of young and old, so the work gets done. Because of God's grace there is feeling in everyone's soul. It is also the grace of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, so the work gets done."
Brahmavihari Swami said, "Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj are in you too, aren't they?"
Swamishri said, "They are, and that is why everything happens through them! The knowledge of Akshar Purushottam spreads in everyone and the work gets done."
Swamishri slipped into singing the praises of everyone's dedication, sacrifice, devotion and faith.
